question: Should the Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should inline autogrow plus the configurable send shortcut remain the intended long-prompt path?
rationale: The requested workflow is still missing and fits web-frontend ergonomics, but it adds a second composition mode with draft, focus, attachment, and send semantics that automation should not choose without UI/product ownership.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Build a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Declare the current autogrow textarea and modifier-send setting sufficient for long prompts, then close or narrow this issue accordingly.

options.title: Defer UX Mode Choice
options.body: Keep this issue open but out of automated repair until a Control UI owner chooses the editor shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Build a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest prior issue-review and send-shortcut decision trail for the overlapping long-prompt composer UX.
